## 📌 Pull Request Description

### Summary of Changes
Provide a clear, concise summary of the documentation added, updated, or fixed in this PR.

### Related Issue
Closes # (issue number)

---

## 🔍 Type of Change
- [ ] 📖 New Documentation / Guide
- [ ] ⌨️ New CLI Command Reference
- [ ] 🔥 New Error Solution
- [ ] 🧪 New Recipe / Pattern
- [ ] 📦 New Package Reference
- [ ] 🛠️ New Developer Tool Guide
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix / Typo correction
- [ ] 🧹 Maintenance / Refactoring

---

## ✅ Contribution Checklist

Before requesting review, please confirm:
- [ ] My code follows the code style and Markdown guidelines of this project.
- [ ] I have added appropriate YAML frontmatter (`title`, `description`, `category`, `topic`, `type`, `level`, `tags`, `platforms`, `lastVerified`).
- [ ] `pnpm validate-content` passes with 0 warnings.
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck` passes with 0 errors.
- [ ] `pnpm lint` passes with 0 errors.
- [ ] `pnpm build` compiles successfully.
- [ ] Any internal markdown links (`/docs/...`, `/commands/...`) are verified and not broken.
